# Particle physics

<!-- Generated by scripts/build_prompts.py. Do not edit by hand. -->

Open only the cards whose "Applies when" line matches the paper. Paths are relative to this folder; the index of all folders is [../../INDEX.md](../../INDEX.md).

| Id | Card | Applies when |
|---|---|---|
| T-ACCELERATOR-PHYSICS | [Accelerator and beam physics](accelerator-physics.md) | the paper reports emittance, energy spread, bunch charge or beam size measured on a radio-frequency, dielectric or other non-plasma accelerator, a luminosity computed from beam parameters, calibration of beam instrumentation, or the gradient or energy gain of a new non-plasma acceleration scheme |
| T-AXION-SEARCHES | [Axion and hidden-sector searches](axion-searches.md) | the paper reports a haloscope, helioscope, light-shining-through-walls or hidden-photon search, or bases a limit on, or a candidate for, an axion-photon coupling, an axion-like particle or a dark photon kinetic mixing on such data |
| T-BLIND-ANALYSIS | [Blind analysis](blind-analysis.md) | the paper states that its analysis was blind or blinded, hid a signal region, the result, the event count or part of the data until unblinding, used a hidden offset or added or removed events, or reports changes made after unblinding |
| T-CALORIMETRY-JETS | [Calorimetry, jets and missing energy](calorimetry-jets.md) | the paper measures energies with calorimeters, reconstructs or calibrates jets, uses missing transverse momentum, or bases a claim on a jet energy scale or resolution, a jet or missing-momentum spectrum, an invariant mass built from jets, or a correction for pile-up |
| CL-STANDARD-MODEL-DEVIATIONS | [Claims of deviations from the Standard Model](standard-model-deviations.md) | the paper reports an anomaly, tension or deviation between a measured quantity and its Standard Model prediction, quotes a significance for that difference, combines such differences in a global fit, or interprets them as a sign of new physics |
| T-AIR-SHOWERS | [Cosmic-ray and air-shower arrays](air-showers.md) | the paper uses a ground array of particle detectors, fluorescence or Cherenkov telescopes to reconstruct extensive air showers, and reports a cosmic-ray energy spectrum, mass composition, depth of shower maximum, muon content, arrival-direction anisotropy or a test of hadronic interaction models |
| T-DARK-MATTER-DIRECT | [Dark matter direct detection](dark-matter-direct.md) | the paper searches for dark matter scattering off nuclei or electrons in a low-background detector, reporting a recoil spectrum, threshold, quenching factor or background model, or claims an excess, an annual modulation or a cross-section exclusion limit from such a search |
| T-DETECTOR-DEVELOPMENT | [Detector development and performance](detector-development.md) | the paper presents a new or prototype particle detector, sensor or readout chip and reports its detection efficiency, spatial, time or energy resolution, rate capability, radiation tolerance or ageing from test-beam, source, laser or irradiation measurements |
| T-FIXED-TARGET | [Fixed-target and beam-dump experiments](fixed-target.md) | the paper searches for new particles made by a proton or electron beam on a fixed target or in a beam dump, through decays or scattering behind a shield or a resonance in the products, or normalizes a yield or limit to particles on target |
| T-MONTE-CARLO-GENERATORS | [Monte Carlo generators and detector simulation](monte-carlo-generators.md) | the paper uses Monte Carlo event generators or detector simulation to predict signals or backgrounds, correct data for detector effects, derive efficiencies or acceptances, or compare a measurement with theory, or relies on a generator tune or simulation-based modelling uncertainty |
| T-NEUTRINO-OSCILLATIONS | [Neutrino oscillation experiments](neutrino-oscillations.md) | the paper measures neutrino oscillation parameters with accelerator, reactor or atmospheric neutrinos, compares near and far detector spectra, reconstructs neutrino energy from final-state particles, or claims a preference for a mass ordering, CP violation or a value of the CP phase |
| T-PRECISION-COLLIDER | [Precision measurements at colliders](precision-collider.md) | the paper reports a total, fiducial or differential cross section measured at a particle collider, corrects collider data for detector effects by unfolding, extracts a Standard Model parameter such as a mass or coupling from such data, or combines such measurements |
| T-RARE-DECAYS | [Rare decays and lepton-flavour violation](rare-decays.md) | the paper measures the branching fraction of a rare decay or sets a limit on a forbidden one, including lepton-flavour-violating decays and muon-to-electron conversion, using a normalisation channel or a count of produced particles and a background estimate in a signal window |
| T-STATISTICAL-INFERENCE-HEP | [Searches and statistical inference in particle physics](statistical-inference-hep.md) | the paper claims a discovery, evidence or significance for a signal, or sets an upper limit, exclusion region or confidence interval on a signal rate, cross section, coupling or other parameter using a likelihood fit, CLs, Feldman-Cousins or Bayesian limits |
| T-TRACKING-PID | [Tracking and particle identification](tracking-pid.md) | the paper reconstructs charged-particle tracks or vertices, applies track, vertex or particle identification selections, quotes tracking efficiency, fake rate, momentum scale or resolution, vertex resolution or misidentification rates, or bases a claim on identified hadrons, leptons or displaced vertices |
| T-TRIGGER-LUMINOSITY | [Trigger, selection efficiency and luminosity](trigger-luminosity.md) | the paper reports a cross section, event rate, branching fraction or limit at a collider that depends on trigger or selection efficiencies, tag-and-probe or data-to-simulation scale factors, integrated luminosity, or the modelling of pile-up |
